entry.title: New: Resolution 286 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
URGES THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO PROCEED WITH THE ACQUISITION OF HONOLULU LANDING IN THE DISTRICT OF PUNA USING THE PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION FUND

Urges the Director of Finance to acquire approximately 364.4 acres of land to protect and preserve cultural and natural resources and open certain areas of the property for educational, gathering, and cultural practices.
